question: With whom did Carl Friedrich Gauss invent the world's first electromagnetic telegraph in 1833?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wilhelm Eduard Weber.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Wilhelm Eduard Weber** was a **German physicist** and, together with Carl Friedrich Gauss, inventor of the first **electromagnetic telegraph.**
 
• Weber was born in **Schlossstrasse in Wittenberg,** where his father,** Michael Weber, was a professor of theology.**
 
• The building had** previously been the home of Abraham Vater.**
 
• Wilhelm was the second of three brothers, all of **whom were distinguished by an aptitude for science**. After the dissolution of the University of Wittenberg, his father was** transferred to Halle in 1815.**
 
• Gauss and Weber constructed the first** electromagnetic telegraph in 1833,**__ which connected the observatory with the institute for physics in Göttingen.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__ **

 
 

 Bernhard Riemann
 
 
 
• Georg Friedrich Bernhard Riemann was a **German mathematician** who made contributions to analysis, number theory, and **differential geometry.**
 
 
 
 

 Pierre-Ernest Weiss
 
 
 
• Pierre-Ernest Weiss (was a French physicist **who specialized in magnetism. **He developed the domain theory of ferromagnetism in 1907.
 
• Weiss domains and the Weiss magneton are named after him.
 
• Weiss also developed the **molecular or mean-field theory, which is often called Weiss-mean-field theory, **that led to the discovery of the Curie–Weiss law.
